description: This file is the backend database interface layer for a mobile service booking website. It manages database schema initialization, data querying, and updates for bookings, services, brands, models, and site content, primarily via Supabase/PostgreSQL.

methods.name: str _table(name: str)
methods.description: Constructs the full table name, including schema if specified, for database queries.

methods.name: Any _sb()
methods.description: Returns a cached Supabase client instance for database operations.

methods.name: Any _sb_exec(query)
methods.description: Executes a Supabase query, normalizes response data, and raises errors if present.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_seeded()
methods.description: Performs a best-effort seed of device brands, models, and repair services if database is uninitialized.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Initializes the database layer and triggers seed data setup for demo purposes.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Retrieves all available services for display in the app.

methods.name: list[dict] list_booking_services()
methods.description: Provides repair service options for the booking step UI.

methods.name: list[dict] list_brands()
methods.description: Lists all device brands available for selection.

methods.name: list[dict] list_models_for_brand(brand: str)
methods.description: Lists models associated with a specific device brand.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Fetches key-value pairs of site content entries by specified keys.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Inserts a new customer repair request into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: str create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Creates a new booking record and returns its UUID.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_device_selection( booking_id: str, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )
methods.description: Updates device and service details for an existing booking.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent bookings, ordered most recent first.

methods.name: dict|None get_booking_by_id(booking_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches booking details via UUID.

methods.name: dict|None get_latest_booking_by_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent booking for a specific phone number.

methods.name: datetime|None _parse_supabase_ts(value: object)
methods.description: Parses timestamps from Supabase into timezone-aware datetime objects.

methods.name: tuple[str,bool] reuse_or_create_pending_booking_within_window( *, name: str, phone: str, pincode: str, window_seconds: int = 120, )
methods.description: Reuses a pending booking within a time window or creates a new one.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_status(booking_id: str, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of an existing booking.

methods.name: bool verify_admin_credentials(username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Checks admin username/password against environment variables for authentication.

ctags.name: create_booking
ctags.pattern: /^def create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: create_customer_request
ctags.pattern: /^def create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str) /
ctags.signature: (name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)

ctags.name: reuse_or_create_pending_booking_within_window
ctags.signature: ( *, name: str, phone: str, pincode: str, window_seconds: int = 120, )

ctags.name: update_booking_device_selection
ctags.signature: ( booking_id: str, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )

ctags.name: update_booking_status
ctags.pattern: /^def update_booking_status(booking_id: str, status: str, notes: str | None = None) -> dict | None/
ctags.signature: (booking_id: str, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
